verdict.rationale: Google Drive's API supports webhook-style push notifications (watch channels) that notify a registered endpoint when a watched resource changes, letting an AI-native integration subscribe to file/change events instead of polling directly for content (google-drive-docs-9, docs-19, docs-28). However, the notifications only signal that a change occurred, requiring a follow-up Changes.list call to get details, and channels must be periodically renewed—both real-world caveats not addressed in the evidence as fully resolved for agentic use. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of using Drive push notifications as webhooks, and detail on payload richness/reliability for AI-agent event-driven workflows.
